info.title: BeeProof AI API
info.description: Evidence-first extraction of bank rate sheets. Open access: no authentication (ADR-004). JSON responses use the {data, meta} envelope; errors use {error}. Wire types match the frontend's lib/types.ts.

parameters.name: process

schema.description: Also queue an extraction job with defaults
schema.title: Process

parameters.description: Also queue an extraction job with defaults

get.description: Published schema versions with fields inline (what the UI needs to start a job).

post.description: Creates a new run for the same document; the response is the new job.
Applies the decision and returns the job's complete new result version.

get.description: EvaluationReport including status while in progress; ?format=md returns the markdown report.

institution_name.title: Institution Name
institution_name.description: From the latest run's results; '' until extracted

job_id.title: Job Id
job_id.description: Latest run; '' when no job exists

status.title: Status
status.description: Latest run status; 'queued' when no job exists

configurations.title: Configurations
configurations.description: native, single_pass, evidence_first (frontend) or extractor_only, validators, validators_witness_a, full (ablation)

result_version.title: Result Version
result_version.description: Defaults to the latest result version

normalized_value.title: Normalized Value
normalized_value.description: decimal string, integer string, ISO date or enum

schema_version_id.title: Schema Version Id
schema_version_id.description: Defaults to the published rate-sheet schema

progress.title: Progress
progress.description: Always null: progress is not measurable per stage

estimated_cost_usd.title: Estimated Cost Usd
estimated_cost_usd.description: null when provider pricing is unknown

id.title: Id
id.description: Schema version id; pass as schema_version_id when creating a job
